fields.label: Company
fields.description: Defaults are per company. A map row never applies to another company.

fields.description: Which family of petty cash row this default applies to.

fields.label: Source Key
fields.description: The specific value within that family — e.g. TG / TE / SE / OA / FD / GP / OT for a Voucher Category, or Wage / Overtime / Piecework / Commission for a Wages Entry. For families with only one variant (Parking, Bike Fuel, Forklift, Loan) repeat the Source Type here.

fields.label: Use as Default
fields.description: Ticked, the posting run pre-fills this account automatically. Unticked, the row is remembered but never applied on its own — the account must be chosen each time.

fields.label: Approved
fields.description: Nothing posts through an unapproved map row. Approving is the deliberate act that lets money reach a ledger.

fields.label: Never post
fields.description: This route is deliberately kept out of the books - commission and piecework while the treatment is open, M-Pesa and bank charges that belong with bank charges. A never-post line still appears on every report and still counts toward the sheet; it simply never reaches a journal.

fields.label: Why it never posts
fields.description: Shown to whoever is approving the line, so a held route explains itself.

fields.label: ERP Account
fields.description: The account debited (or credited, for a float) in the ERPNext Journal Entry.

fields.label: Party Type
fields.description: Required when the ERP account is Receivable or Payable — e.g. Employee Advances. The party itself comes from the petty cash row.

fields.label: QBO Account
fields.description: Leave blank if this source should never reach QuickBooks.

fields.label: QBO Tax Code
fields.description: Set for VAT-claimable spend (SP-16). Only ever applied to rows that actually carry an ETR receipt.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Why this account was chosen. Worth a line — the next person to look will not remember.
